text.p: These are the main headlines news reported by Radio Latvia on Thursday at noon.
Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Italian president Oscar Luigi Scalfaro ends the Latvian leg of his Baltic visit today.
- The LNNK and Peasants' Union factions are today expected to pick their candidate for the defence post.
- "Baltic sea region and EU" conference on involving producers in the integration process started in Riga.
- The central depository will handle securities transactions of paper not quoted on the bourse in a month's time.
